urlText: L2 and L3 partial line closures during Vivid Sydney on Fridays and weekends
content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services will be partially closed on Friday nights and weekends.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will not run between Town Hall and Circular Quay due to road closures and for pedestrian safety on the following days and times:
    • Fridays from 6pm to 1am
    • Weekends from 5pm to 1am (Saturdays, Sundays and public holiday Mon 9 Jun)

  • Light rail services will continue to run between Town Hall and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford during these times. L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will run as per normal during Vivid Sydney from 5am to 1am daily.
  • If you’re travelling to Circular Quay, continue on foot from Town Hall or change for trains.
  • Note on Saturdays and on Sunday 8 June from 6pm to 11pm, Sydney Trains services will not drop off passengers at Circular Quay Station – use Wynyard, Martin Place or St James stations instead.
  • Allow extra travel time as services will be very busy. Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more details on transport services during the event.

urlText: Erskine St/King Street Wharf diversions during Vivid Sydney
content:
During Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June, route 288, 290 and 292 buses will be using different stops due to road closures and expected heavy traffic.
  • From 5pm to 1am on Saturdays and Sunday of the long weekend (8 June) buses will start and end trips at Wynyard instead of Sussex St near King St Wharf.
  • Buses to the city will end trips at Wynyard Station York Street Stand P (200048). Buses leaving the city will start trips from Wynyard Station Clarence Street Stand R near Margaret St (2000142). 
  • Continue on foot from Wynyard via the underground Wynyard Walk to reach the King St Wharf or Barangaroo precincts. Allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for the alternative stop locations.
  • Visit the Vivid Sydney event page for more transport details.
Missed stops
  • Sussex St at Erskine St (200013)
  • Clarence St opp Barrack St (2000189)
  • Sussex St before Erskine St (200018)

urlText: Allow extra travel time as Kiss and Ride upgrade is underway at Leppington Station
content:
Road work is underway to improve the Kiss and Ride zone north of Leppington Station.
  • A reduced speed limit of 40km/h will be in place on the approach to Leppington Station from both directions.
  • A temporary Kiss and Ride zone is available in the commuter car park south of Leppington Station.
  • Access to the multi-storey commuter car park will remain open.
  • Work will take place between 7am to 6pm, Monday to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays.
Please allow extra travel time. View the project page for more information on the upgrade.
